_note: Group A (2026-10-01): what the player may choose to look like at creation. Settled by Yannick from docs/CREATION_AND_GEAR.md: six hair styles, eight hair colours, five skin tones, four beards, six colours for the starting clothes; no eyes (two pixels on screen) and no build (barely visible, and it would stretch his brushwork). Each colour is a recolouring in the recipes' terms - hue in degrees, saturation scale, saturation floor, value scale - applied live by the paper-doll shader; null means his own pixels. The first of each list is the default, and the defaults together are his traveller exactly. Chosen once, at creation; never changed after (Yannick).
_hair_styles_note: spiky is his brother's own hair; the others are painted from its texture (A4). shaved shows the head his hair hides.
_beards_note: In the hair's colour. Seen from the front and the side; from behind there is none to see.
_clothes_note: The colour of the cloth tunic the player starts in (group E's first item). Ochre is left out on purpose: it is the works' livery, and the king's red is his men's.
_backpack_note: The backpack stays on the player and on nobody else since group L: it is how he is found in a crowd (Yannick, 2026-10-01).
